tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bane_nightmare_Desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bane_nightmare_Face: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bane_nightmare_Lore: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bane_nightmare_Note: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bane_nightmare_abil: Hero that drafts Nightmare can continue to attack Nightmared units. Bane can also attack even if he didn't draft this ability.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_bane_bio: When the gods have nightmares, it is Bane Elemental who brings them.  Also known as Atropos, Bane was born from the midnight terrors of the goddess Nyctasha.  A force of terror too powerful to be contained by sleep, he surfaced from her slumbers, fed upon her immortality, and stole his vaporous form from her inky blood.  He is the essence of fear.  Mortals who hear his voice hear their darkest secrets whispered in their ear.  He calls to the hidden fear in every Hero's heart.  Wakefulness is no protection, for Bane's black blood, continuously dripping, is a tar that traps his enemies in nightmare.  In the presence of Bane, every Hero remembers to fear the dark.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bane_hype: Bane brings terror to his enemies with his arsenal of disabling abilities. Whether trapping a foe within a contagious nightmare, or gripping an enemy in place, he gives allies all the time they need to slay their enemy.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bane_npedesc1: Puts his enemies to sleep, incapacitating them

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Applies a permanent status resistance reduction debuff stack on the dying enemy hero.

The status resistance reduction is only applied to debuff sourced to Bane.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Ichor of Nyctasha: Haunted by the terrors of being slain by Bane. Status Resistance to Bane's debuffs increased by x%.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Resist|Status}}
** The status resistance values of this source stack additively per applied stack. 
** Stacks multiplicatively with other status resistance sources.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
*** Applies a permanent debuff stack that only affects debuff sourced to Bane in the following conditions:
**** Upon a kill credited to Bane.

mechanics
